scope_matrix.eligibility: Additional imported gravel/broken rock when subgrade/ditch material is insufficient. Specialized processed material, geofabric/geogrids/corduroy and certain inseparable ECE works use other procedures. Not available for snow/ice roads.

scope_matrix.locator: CAM 5.3.3.1/Table 5-1, printed 5-14 to 5-16; official training pp12,15; Interior ECE Item Q p54
separate_components: eligible additional stabilization haul beyond 3.2 km
scope_matrix.note: Bundled scope differs from Interior subgrade. Never add full imported stabilization again without assessing overlap.

Part A is the installed structure total; Part B is supply/delivery per metre. Do not multiply Part A by length or add Part B to Part A. Culverts below 950 mm are already included in ordinary tabular subgrade. ECE is required above 1.8 m diameter or above 20 m length; 20 m itself is tabulated. No interpolation.

includes: culvert materials including couplers when required
scope_matrix.note: Column A includes materials and installation; Column B is the materials-only alternative for applicable non-tabular estimates. Use A or B as appropriate; never add B to A. Pipe diameters 0.3-1.8 m. Wood culverts up to 3.4 m span have a separate CAD 2,700 allowance. Ordinary Coast tabular road costs exclude these culvert allowances.

scope_matrix.limits: Single-span, single-lane steel girders6-15m, timber decks,4.268m width, specified sill/lock-block foundations1-2tiers. Components are combined to match design; a girder purchase rate is not the complete bridge. Delivery beyond200km can qualify for additional ECE.
Specified2.0-25.4m spans,0-2.4m abutments,L60-L165; excludes multispan, certain piles/reused bridges/extra width/out-of-table cases.

includes: operator wages and benefits for all-found equipment
scope_matrix.note: Do not add operator/benefits/overhead a second time. Small equipment may exclude labour; check row. Interior wage rows already include 50% payroll loading.

interior_eligibility.note: Rock percentage is an applicability gate; it is not a coefficient in the2026 tabular subgrade equation. Small segments must follow aggregation rules; typical sections>=1km, exceptions>=100m.

geographic_notes.note: Interior North includes Northeast,Omineca,Skeena except the identified coastal TSA portion; South includes Cariboo,Kootenay-Boundary,Thompson-Okanagan. Region alone does not choose the road group.

RoadGroup1 is a hybrid: Coast bank-height road tables where eligible, Interior pipe-culvert and nonlog-bridge methods, Coast log-bridge/wood-culvert methods; possible additional stabilization haul beyond3.2km. Do not assign a regular Interior group equation.

implementation_notes: Keep comparisons separate from estimate writes.
Use explicit component inclusion/exclusion tags to avoid culvert,operator,haul or stabilization double counting.
Store effective date and cost-base year separately from verification date.
Keep source units unchanged; installed structure costs and per-metre materials costs are different fields.
Use exact authority/road-group boundaries and verified site conditions rather than one average per natural-resource region.
Real project budgets may include items omitted from appraisal because accounted for elsewhere in stumpage. Appraisal exclusion is not zero real-world cost.
2026 ECE culvert/special-structure approach fills included in structure costs must be deducted from road subgrade overlap.
Source retrieval can be stale in search snippets; current landing-page clicks yielded correct2026 manuals.
Keep IAM fixed appraisal fuel add-ons distinct from transportation monthly hired-equipment fuel adjustments; they are separate pricing methods.

interior_appraisal_fuel_addons.note: Explicit IAM appraisal add-ons. They differ from monthly transportation hired-equipment fuel supplements; do not automatically substitute the latter into an appraisal comparison.

interior_crew_addons.locator: Appendix I; printed A-8; PDF index 152
interior_crew_addons.conditions: Only where qualifying costs are incurred and not already included elsewhere in the appraisal; camp qualification applies.
